def check_collision_time(ant1, ant2):
    """
    Calculates the time until ant1 and ant2 collide, if they are moving towards each other
    along the same axis.
    Returns infinity if no imminent collision, or the positive collision time t.
    """
    t_x = float('inf')
    t_y = float('inf')
    
    # Check X-axis collision (must be opposing X velocity AND same Y velocity)
    if ant1.vy == ant2.vy and ant1.vx * ant2.vx < 0 and ant1.vx != 0:

        # Relative speed is |ant1.vx - ant2.vx| = 2.

    # Check Y-axis collision (must be opposing Y velocity AND same X velocity)
    if ant1.vx == ant2.vx and ant1.vy * ant2.vy < 0 and ant1.vy != 0:

        # Relative speed is |ant1.vy - ant2.vy| = 2.
        t_y = dy / (ant1.vy - ant2.vy)
            
    # We only consider the collision that happens earliest and is positive.
    t = min(t_x, t_y)
